Libya Update (Reuters) - unified budget worth 190 billion dinars

en.summary: In April 2026 the eastern House of Representatives and the western High Council of State agreed Libya's first unified budget in 13 years, LYD 190bn (about $30bn). It allots LYD 40bn to development and LYD 12bn to the National Oil Corporation, with development priorities set by a joint committee under central bank supervision. Haftar's forces control major oil fields and export terminals.
en.leader: Prime Minister Abdul Hamid Dbeibah (Government of National Unity, Tripoli) / the east is held by Khalifa Haftar's Libyan National Army
agenda: Execute the LYD 190bn unified budget (salaries 73bn, subsidies 37bn, development 40bn)
Nationwide development projects (joint committee, central bank oversight)
Higher oil output (LYD 12bn for NOC)
Fiscal stability and ending the east-west split
Prepare elections (no date set)
needs: Design and construction for power, water and road projects
Oil and gas maintenance and equipment for higher output
Public finance management systems (estimate)

es.summary: En abril de 2026, la Cámara de Representantes del este y el Alto Consejo de Estado del oeste acordaron el primer presupuesto unificado en 13 años, de 190.000 millones de dinares (unos 30.000 millones de USD). Asigna 40.000 millones al desarrollo y 12.000 millones a la Corporación Nacional del Petróleo; un comité conjunto supervisado por el banco central fija las prioridades. Las fuerzas de Haftar controlan los principales campos y terminales.

fr.summary: En avril 2026, la Chambre des représentants (est) et le Haut Conseil d'État (ouest) ont adopté le premier budget unifié depuis 13 ans, de 190 Md LYD (environ 30 Md USD). Il prévoit 40 Md pour le développement et 12 Md pour la Compagnie nationale du pétrole, un comité conjoint sous supervision de la banque centrale fixant les priorités. Les forces de Haftar contrôlent les principaux champs et terminaux.

vi.summary: Tháng 4/2026, Hạ viện phía đông và Hội đồng Nhà nước Tối cao phía tây thống nhất ngân sách chung đầu tiên sau 13 năm, 190 tỷ dinar (khoảng 30 tỷ USD). id.summary: Pada April 2026, Dewan Perwakilan di timur dan Dewan Tinggi Negara di barat menyepakati anggaran terpadu pertama dalam 13 tahun sebesar LYD 190 miliar (sekitar US$30 miliar). Anggaran mengalokasikan LYD 40 miliar untuk pembangunan dan LYD 12 miliar untuk Perusahaan Minyak Nasional, dengan prioritas pembangunan ditetapkan komite bersama di bawah pengawasan bank sentral. Pasukan Haftar menguasai ladang dan terminal ekspor utama.
id.leader: Perdana Menteri Abdul Hamid Dbeibah (Pemerintah Persatuan Nasional, Tripoli) / wilayah timur dikuasai Tentara Nasional Libya pimpinan Khalifa Haftar
